name: Push-Up
description: Standard push-ups targeting chest, shoulders, and triceps. Keep core tight and body straight throughout the movement.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: Full range of motion squats for legs and glutes. Drive through your heels and keep your chest up.

name: Pull-Up
description: Overhand-grip pull-ups for back width and biceps. Aim for full extension at the bottom.

name: Plank
description: Hold a rigid plank position, core braced, for the target duration. Builds foundational core strength.

name: Dumbbell Row
description: Bent-over single-arm rows targeting the lats and rhomboids. Keep back flat and drive elbow to ceiling.

name: Pike Push-Up
description: Shoulder-targeting push-up variation from a downward dog position. Great for overhead pressing strength.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Single-leg squat with rear foot elevated. Excellent for unilateral leg strength and hip flexibility.

name: Diamond Push-Up
description: Narrow-grip push-up with hands forming a diamond. Isolates the triceps more intensely.

name: Inverted Row
description: Horizontal pulling movement using a bar or table edge. Builds upper back thickness and posture.

name: Jump Squat
description: Explosive squat variation jumping at the top. Builds power, stamina, and burns more calories.

name: Lunges
description: Step forward into a deep lunge, alternating legs. Trains quads, glutes, and hip flexors.

name: Dips
description: Parallel bar dips targeting chest and triceps. Control the descent and drive up powerfully.

name: Burpee
description: Full-body conditioning exercise combining squat, push-up, and jump. A true test of stamina.

name: Mountain Climbers
description: Running-in-place in push-up position. Excellent cardio and core challenge combined.

name: Hip Thrust
description: Glute bridge with shoulders on bench. The most effective exercise for glute development.
